Free shuttle to Columbus Airport

We’re one mile from the terminals at John Glenn Columbus International Airport via our free airport shuttle. Columbus State Community College and Easton Town Center are within 10 minutes, and Downtown Columbus attractions are seven miles away. Enjoy free parking, our pet-friendly rooms, and breakfast, dinner, and evening room service on site.
